energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (@ cb5b641). Direct 5V SOM DC shunt on AMD Kria and rail shunt on Jetson Thor, strictly orthogonal to chip counters, analytical estimates, and unmetered work.

claims.statement: Advanced computing becomes affordable for everyone when expensive neural models act as a last resort behind fast local lookup tables, search indexes, and exact solvers.

Compressing weights below one bit saves memory, yet unpacking them back to floating-point numbers at runtime wastes over eighty times more circuit-board energy than running packed integer logic directly.

One integer kernel checked by cryptographic hashes produces the exact same answer across processors, graphics cards, WebAssembly, hardware logic, and microcontrollers, halting immediately if a single weight changes.

easy_read.easy_title: Lookup First, Integer Kernels, and Real Shunt Energy
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This capstone position paper explains how to make advanced computing fast, verifiable, and affordable.
Advanced computing becomes affordable for everyone when expensive neural models act as a last resort behind fast local lookup tables, search indexes, and exact solvers.

Compressing weights below one bit saves memory, yet unpacking them back to floating-point numbers at runtime wastes over eighty times more circuit-board energy than running packed integer logic directly.

One integer kernel checked by cryptographic hashes produces the exact same answer across processors, graphics cards, WebAssembly, hardware logic, and microcontrollers, halting immediately if a single weight changes.
Key result: 26.58 times Kria and 16.26 times Jetson Thor board shunt energy cuts across the four-stage cascade.
Real direct-current shunt sensors measured hardware energy under Signed Provenance, Self-Checked.
